1: ## 1. Project Root & Config Setup
2: 
3: - [ ] 1.1 Create `composer.json` at repo root with PSR-4 autoload mapping `App\` → `app/`
4: - [ ] 1.2 Create `.env.example` with all config keys (DB_HOST, DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASS, DB_CHARSET, SITE_NAME, SITE_URL, BASE_PATH, GEMINI_API_KEY, HF_API_KEY)
5: - [ ] 1.3 Create `.env` from `.env.example` with current database values
6: - [ ] 1.4 Create `.htaccess` with Apache rewrite rules (RewriteEngine On, forward non-file/non-dir to index.php)
7: - [ ] 1.5 Create `.gitignore` with vendor/, .env, uploads/*, *.log entries
8: - [ ] 1.6 Create `.editorconfig` with consistent coding style rules
9: - [ ] 1.7 Run `composer install` to generate `vendor/autoload.php`
10: 
11: ## 2. Core Framework Classes
12: 
13: - [ ] 2.1 Create `app/Core/Router.php` — Router class with `get()`, `post()`, `dispatch()` methods
14: - [ ] 2.2 Create `app/Core/Session.php` — Session class with `start()`, `get()`, `set()`, `flash()` static methods
15: - [ ] 2.3 Create `app/Core/Controller.php` — Base Controller with `view()` method that loads views with layout
16: - [ ] 2.4 Create `app/Core/Mailer.php` — Mailer class for email sending functionality
17: 
18: ## 3. Config & Database
19: 
20: - [ ] 3.1 Create `config/database.php` — PDO connection using `getenv()` values from .env

22: 
23: ## 4. Helpers
24: 
25: - [ ] 4.1 Create `app/helpers.php` — consolidate utility functions: `clean()`, `timeAgo()`, `callAI()`, `callGeminiAPI()`, `callHuggingFaceAPI()`, `getDB()`, `base_url()`, `redirect()`, `asset()`

49: ## 7. Views

70: - [ ] 8.5 Register AJAX routes (/ajax/ai-compact, /ajax/ai-suggest, /ajax/bookmark, /ajax/upvote, /ajax/mu-result, /ajax/run-python, /ajax/run-sql)
71: - [ ] 8.6 Register admin routes (/admin, /admin/manage-attendance, /admin/api-settings)

73: ## 9. Assets & Static Files
74:

76: - [ ] 9.2 Create `assets/js/main.js` for shared JavaScript
77: - [ ] 9.3 Create `uploads/` directory with `.gitkeep`

87: ## 11. SQL & Database
